summary: Dominion Energy filed an 8-K on May 15, 2026, announcing a definitive merger agreement with NextEra Energy. Under the terms, NextEra will acquire Dominion through a two-step merger structure, with Dominion shareholders receiving cash consideration totaling $360 million, allocated on a pro rata basis per share. The Board unanimously approved the deal and recommends shareholder approval at a special meeting. Post-closing, NextEra will expand its board to include four Dominion designees and maintain Dominion's Richmond and Cayce offices. The transaction is structured as a reverse subsidiary merger followed by an upstream merger. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory approvals.
